rejected_inferences.reason: Registry presence assertions establish that lease tools are registered, but do not call pitwall_lease_pod or prove lease creation; no lease_pod behavioral binding is claimed.
Exact 78-tool registry assertions are inventory/registration checks, not aggregate behavior proof for every tool.
initialize and capabilities assertions prove stdio handshake only; they do not establish behavior for a named business tool.
Feature spec/schema tests verify names and credential-free input schema only; they are not direct tool-call outcome evidence.
The shared contract fixture uses mocked pools/repositories and direct Python handler calls; it cannot prove durable database behavior, MCP transport, provider work, or spend.
